resume: Five-track synth, sampler and groovebox (four synth or sampler tracks plus one drum track), with 14 engines, a 64-step sequencer, a chord progression generator and an arpeggiator. It is built on Felucca, whose documentation makes up most of the README.

commandes.role: On action pages and in prompts, goes back; in the menu, changes the value.
On action pages and in prompts, executes; in the menu, changes the value.
Effects page; held, a layer of performance effects on the keys.
Scale page (SCL in the docs); held, shortcuts on the keys.
LFO pages; held with a knob turned, a momentary change that reverts on release.
Sound editing pages; held, EDIT layer on the keys.
SONG page; held, GLO layer (mutes, solos, levels, tap tempo).
Cycles through HOME, MIXER and CLOCK; held, opens the menu.
USER, PRESETS, PHRASES, PROJECT, TOOLS pages; held, undoes.
STEP, DETAIL, AUTOMATION pages; held, sequence tools on the keys.
Arms the track; held, REC layer (erase, click, count-in).
Changes the sound, from any page that is not a list.
Selects the track on each page.

gestes: FX, GLO, SEL, EDIT, REC or SEQ held: quick layer; double-tap: it stays open.
SAVE held: undoes the last change.
a_savoir: The README mixes the presentation of Loom (five tracks) with the documentation of Felucca (four tracks): the controls section comes from the latter.
